title.zh: CFTC Asks Judge to Dismiss CME Lawsuit Over Crypto Perpetual Futures

current_state.zh: The CFTC asked a federal judge to dismiss CME's lawsuit challenging its approval of crypto perpetual futures, arguing CME has shown no financial harm.
